title: UFO over Sonoma State College art event, predicted by Owens
summary: Jeffrey Mishlove tells of UFO over Sonoma State College art event, predicted by Owens, about December 1976 at Sonoma State, Rohnert Park, California, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Sonoma State College, Rohnert Park, California

tellings.quote: art department, about a hundred people, were out there with their cameras and videotape in December 1976 and a UFO appeared right over the campus uh about 3,000 ft above the campus.

plain: Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher of psychic phenomena, says a man named Ted Owens, who claimed he could make UFOs appear, predicted one would show up over an art department event at Sonoma State College in California. According to Mishlove, about a hundred people were outside with cameras and videotape in December 1976 when a UFO appeared roughly 3,000 feet above the campus. He says it made the front page of the Berkeley Gazette and the Channel 9 evening news, which would mean someone could summon these things on cue.
